name: Improved Feint Partner [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Knowledge of your companions’ tricks and techniques allow your allies to take even greater advantage of your feints.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank, Combat Reflexes, Feint Partner, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully feint against an opponent, that opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from your ally.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
